Package com.codedstreams.otterstreams.sql.cep

Class CEPInferenceIntegration

java.lang.Object
com.codedstreams.otterstreams.sql.cep.CEPInferenceIntegration
public class CEPInferenceIntegration extends Object
Provides integration between Flink CEP (Complex Event Processing) and machine learning inference engines.

This utility class allows attaching ML-based conditions to Flink CEP Pattern objects, so that events can be filtered or matched based on predictions from a pre-trained ML model.

Example usage: 


 Pattern<MyEvent, MyEvent> pattern = Pattern.<MyEvent>begin("start")
     .next("next")
     .where(CEPInferenceIntegration.withMLCondition(
         "myModel",
         event -> Map.of("feature1", event.getValue()),
         score -> score > 0.8
     ));

  • Method Details

    • withMLCondition

      public static <T> org.apache.flink.cep.pattern.Pattern<T,T> withMLCondition(org.apache.flink.cep.pattern.Pattern<T,T> pattern, String modelName, Function<T,Map<String,Object>> featureExtractor, Predicate<Double> scorePredicate)
      Attaches a machine learning-based condition to a Flink CEP pattern.

      The condition evaluates each event by extracting features using the provided featureExtractor, sending them to the ML model identified by modelName, and testing the resulting score with scorePredicate.

      Type Parameters:
      T - The type of events in the CEP pattern.
      Parameters:
      pattern - The Flink CEP pattern to attach the ML condition to.
      modelName - The name of the ML model to use for inference. The model should be registered in the ModelCache.
      featureExtractor - A function that extracts features from an event of type T as a Map of feature names to values.
      scorePredicate - A predicate that evaluates the numeric prediction score returned by the ML model.
      Returns:
      The original pattern with the ML-based condition applied.
